retrievalProfile.description: A centered female portrait framed by a soft vignette and large sunflowers, utilizing a split-title layout with classic serif typography.
triggerTerms: vignetted portrait with split header and footer text

recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, soft-focus portrait of a woman holding a large bouquet of sunflowers, set against a blurred golden background. The image is framed by a white border, with large, light-blue serif text split between the top and bottom of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered behind a foreground floral element
Soft vignette transition between the central photo and white border
Text color sampled from cool tones to contrast warm imagery
Hierarchical split between large name and smaller subtitle
coreInvariants: Sunflower bouquet as a primary foreground element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-close-up portrait, scaled to occupy 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central sunflower in the bouquet, positioned just below the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top large name, down to the subject's eyes, through the sunflowers, to the bottom large name.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial white border surrounding the central vignetted image.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm golden yellows and browns in the central image.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted powder blue for the primary typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep greens in the sunflower leaves.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the flowers against a desaturated, high-value white background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large uppercase serif for names paired with small, widely tracked italic serif for descriptive text.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic high-contrast serif with elegant proportions.
Traditional feel that matches the 90s country aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus portrait of a woman with long hair holding a bouquet of bright sunflowers, set against a blurred golden field. Apply a heavy white vignette that fades into a solid white square border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large uppercase serif text in powder blue at the top and bottom margins. Add a single line of small, italicized, widely-spaced white text centered just below the top blue text.

verificationChecks: Is the text color powder blue?
Is there a soft vignette between the photo and the white border?
Are the sunflowers the primary foreground element?
Is the typography a high-contrast serif?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Original album title and artist name
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the vignette.
Check that the sunflowers look natural and vibrant.
Verify the white border is perfectly square and clean.
Confirm the serif font has sharp, elegant details.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central soft-focus portrait + sunflower foreground + heavy white vignette + split serif typography in muted blue.
